verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's first-party multi-region docs say its multi-region capabilities make it easier to run global applications. Table locality settings determine how CockroachDB optimizes access to a table's data, and survival goals control replica fault tolerance. Community comments describe it as a worldwide cluster with global transactions and mention follower reads, though some note multi-region and follower-read features have been gated behind enterprise licensing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific locality options (e.g., regional-by-row or global tables) and their read-latency effects, first-party docs on follower reads, and independent hands-on latency benchmarks.
